The select vehicles in this program are Authorized Reacquired Vehicles we can offer to the general public at reduced pricing.    What is the Manufacture Buy-Back Program?  The program allows for vehicles, though previously sold as new that were returned because of nonconformity to Ford's expressed warranty, to be offered to the public once repaired.  Most vehicles in the program either did not complete repairs in a reasonable amount of time or the customer who purchased the original vehicle is still not satisfied with the status.   Why buy a Manufacture Buy-Back?  Huge savings passed directly to the public.  Vehicles in this category are offered at prices substantially lower than their current retail value.  In addition to the savings, Ford offers to give the purchaser the balance of the original factory warranty or a 12 month/12,000-mile warranty, whichever is greater. We disclose the cause of repurchase and all of the vehicles warranty history before any purchase. You may also ask for this information before visiting the store.  While it's true that vehicles repurchased by a manufacturer may need repairs to correct problems, that isn't always the case, causes are often minor.  Some of the problems are fixed while the customer still owns the vehicle but are still repurchased as a gesture of goodwill to maintain a valued relationship with a loyal customer.  Regardless of the reason for a buyback, when a true problem does exist, the manufacturer not only wants to fix it, the company is required by law to fully correct any issues before the vehicle is offered for sale.   What does Zink Motor Company do to ensure the vehicles are fixed correctly?  Any vehicle that cannot be fully repaired will then be recycled and not offered to the public again. Crosstrek Limited Additional Equipment I ($1,795 value) Convenience Unresponsive driver assistant - a reaction to inaction. Maybe you fell asleep. Maybe you lost consciousness. No matter how it happens, Unresponsive driver assistant works to help lessen the danger when it does. It detects prolonged driver unresponsiveness, automatically bringing the vehicle to a stop and turning on the hazard lights. If equipped, emergency services will also be contacted. Unresponsive driver assistant is safety that never sleeps.Safety and Security Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down; speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control. Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life.  When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident.  Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead. Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety.  Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. description: This 2024 Ford Mustang GT Premium in striking Blue delivers the performance and presence you're looking for in a true American sports car. Color-accented door trim, wrapped knee bolsters, and an accent-stitched center console create an upscale cabin environment. The leather-trimmed bucket seats provide comfort during spirited drives, while the split-folding rear seat adds practicality when needed. Premium touches like the illuminated entry and overhead console enhance both functionality and ambiance. Safety is paramount in this Mustang. Ford Co-Pilot360 Assist+ integrates multiple protection systems including lane-keeping technology, blind spot monitoring, and evasive steering assist. The pre-collision system uses automatic emergency braking to help prevent accidents, while the comprehensive airbag system and electronic stability control work together to keep you secure. On the road, this Mustang delivers responsive handling with four-wheel independent suspension and speed-sensing steering. The 19" shadow silver-painted aluminum wheels wear performance-grade tires, while the branded brake system with red-painted calipers provides confident stopping power. You'll appreciate the available 16 city and 24 highway MPG efficiency for a V8 of this caliber. The infotainment setup keeps you connected with SYNC 4.0 QNX, connected built-in navigation, and SiriusXM 360L satellite radio. Its three-row seating arrangement accommodates up to eight passengers, with split-folding rear seats that expand cargo flexibility. description: Meet the 2024 GMC Sierra 2500HD Denali, a powerful diesel pickup engineered for both capability and refined comfort. This truck combines the strength you need for serious work with the sophistication expected in a premium full-size pickup.- Duramax 6.6L V8 Turbodiesel engine with 470 hp and 975 lb-ft of torque- Max Trailering Package with gooseneck/5th wheel prep provisions- Heavy-Duty Front Spring/Camper Package- Denali Reserve Package with power sunroof- 12-way power driver and passenger seats with lumbar support- Heated and ventilated front seats- Forge Perforated Leather-Appointed front seat trim- Bose Premium 7-Speaker sound system with SiriusXM 360L- Premium GMC Infotainment System with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto- Multicolor 15" diagonal head-up display- HD Surround Vision with bed view camera and trailer camera provisions- Adaptive Cruise Control with Lane Departure Warning- Automatic Emergency Braking with Front Pedestrian BrakingThe Sierra 2500HD arrives finished in Black with the Signature Chrome Denali Grille, establishing authority on any jobsite or street. Its aggressive exterior styling is matched by thoughtful details like the spray-on bedliner with Denali logo, LED cargo lighting, and polished exhaust tip. Rain-sensing wipers and fully automatic headlights respond to changing conditions without your input.Inside, the cabin reflects Denali-level refinement. Genuine wood dashboard and door panel inserts complement the leather-appointed seats. Heated steering wheel, wireless phone projection, and wireless charging pad integrate modern conveniences throughout the cabin. The dual-zone automatic climate control keeps all occupants comfortable, while the overhead console and floor-mounted center console provide practical storage solutions.This truck's trailering capabilities are comprehensive. The integrated trailer brake controller, hitch guidance with hitch view, and in-vehicle trailering system app give you control and confidence when towing. Trailer side blind zone alert and rear cross traffic alert add layers of awareness. The 220-amp alternator ensures sufficient electrical capacity for your demands.Capability extends to all-terrain performance with the X31 Off-Road Package, 2-speed active transfer case, and hill descent control. Electronic stability control, traction control, and the off-road suspension work together to maintain composure in varied conditions. The 4-wheel disc brake system with ABS provides confident stopping power.On-road safety is equally prioritized with forward collision alert, automatic high-beam management, and ultrasonic front and rear park assist. OnStar and GMC Connected Services provide emergency communication and vehicle diagnostics.
